items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: He had his own band, but he had, John Cashman was playing with him, see. Me, I was playing with him.

ctx.x: Now we had a... Now that's not the same guy as Mutt Carey. Mutt Carey. No. No. Mutt Carter. Do you remember Mutt and Jack Carey, the two brothers? Yeah.

Mutt Carter, yeah. He had his own band, but he had, John Cashman was playing with him, see. Me, I was playing with him. They had, they had two, uh, two Cashmans. John, John Cashman, John had a brother, played drum. His brother's name now. Yeah.

I can't remember. I know there's a Sam that played guitar and a Willie that played, Bill Cashman that played saxophone. Well, he got a brother, had a brother played drum. Well, I, I, I know, I asked John that and he told me. So I got it down on tape, you know.
